summary.text: Kathi Paquette is a Republican state representative from Hillsborough 25 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election (listed by Ballotpedia as Kathleen Paquette).
Paquette has worked as a physical therapist, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Kathleen Paquette earned a bachelor's degree from Notre Dame College.
She lost the Hillsborough 25 general election on November 8, 2022, and won it on November 5, 2024.
